sources.snippet: Moreitems Kodr Every open model. One API. Available as fast as it drops. Kodr is a developer-first gateway for open-source AI models. It discovers models from the Hugging Face Hub, surfaces models that are actually runnable through inference providers, and exposes a clean OpenAI-compatible developer experience.
